jars: The work of steadiness is in where you let your mind rest.
Let them see you fully, without the manager in your head.
best: It is not the milk that set you off. It is the part of you that has not been held, and when it finally breaks, it breaks on the one you love most.
day1_verdict: The first verse names the exact weight I'm carrying—the shame and the fear of becoming my mother—and the 'for you' makes me feel seen instead of judged.
